The first term is $14$ and the common difference is $16$.

| $\footnotesize\maroonC{+16\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | | $\footnotesize\maroonC{+16\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | | $\footnotesize\maroonC{+16\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | |
:-: |  :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-:
$14,$ | | $30,$ | | $46,$ | | $62,...$

This is the recursive formula of $14, 30, 46, 62,...$

$\begin{cases}
d(1)=14
\\\\
d(n)=d(n-1)+16
\end{cases}$
